## Cohen and Lin (2014), static GGA+U FeSiO3 PPv-II Vinet

**untested** (not refittable) · `fesio3_post_perovskite_ii_cohen_lin_2014_vinet_1` · `Vinet` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/fesio3_post_perovskite_ii.md#record-fesio3_post_perovskite_ii_cohen_lin_2014_vinet_1)

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization. **Basis:** The energy-volume observations remain plot-only after source exhaustion. Table III independently prints V100=34.49 A3/FeSiO3, K100=580 GPa, and K100'=3.44; the Table I lattice product gives 34.4492 A3/FeSiO3.
